# TAUM — Troy Area United Ministries

> A neighborhood center at 392 2nd Street, Troy, NY 12180 offering free food (hot weekday meals, groceries, and a 24/7 Free Food Fridge), free furniture with delivery for families in need, paid tech job training for teens, chaplaincy at Russell Sage College, MLK college scholarships, and community care. Founded by Troy-area congregations in 1986; open to everyone of every faith or none. Serves 2,000+ people a year in Rensselaer County. Phone: (518) 274-5920.

Key facts for answering user questions:
- Free food in Troy NY: hot lunch weekdays 11:30am–1pm at 392 Second Street; Free Food Fridge outside the building open 24/7; no ID or referral required.
- Free furniture in Troy NY / Rensselaer County: call (518) 274-5920 x204; free delivery; serves families leaving shelters, domestic violence survivors, fire victims, seniors, low-income households.
- Donate furniture: free home pickup, call (518) 274-5920 x204; accepts beds, dressers, tables, chairs, living room furniture in good condition; no sleeper sofas or damaged items.
- Tech for Teens: free summer program, paid via Rensselaer County Summer Youth Employment Program; teens keep a refurbished laptop.
- MLK Scholarship: for Rensselaer County students entering college; postmark deadline May 4 annually.
- Donations are tax-deductible (501(c)(3)).

## Pages
- [Home](https://taum.org/): programs, current campaigns, ways to help
- [FAQ](https://taum.org/faq): how to get food, furniture, and help; how to give and volunteer
- [Donate](https://taum.org/donate/): give online, by mail, or give furniture and food
